intent: Two Claude sessions can no longer drive the phone at the same time: every android_ui call and every phone_deploy.sh run takes a per-serial lease owned by the session, and a foreign holder is refused by name with the alternatives spelled out.
scope: python_pkg/phone_lease (new): lease file, owner identity, acquire/release/status, CLI
python_pkg/android_ui/cli.py: acquire the lease before every command (exit 3 when held elsewhere)
Non-goal: parallel driving of one screen; that is what the virtual display / emulator scripts in ~/.claude/scripts are for
changes: flock-guarded JSON lease per serial under ~/.cache/phone-lease/, 180 s TTL refreshed on every call
owner = nearest ancestor `claude` process (one per session); PHONE_LEASE_OWNER overrides
android_ui main() refuses with exit 3 and the holder's name; phone_deploy.sh exits 40

verification.evidence: all hooks passed; python_pkg 1886 passed, 100% line+branch coverage

verification.command: python3 -m python_pkg.android_ui -s 23181JEGR08034 focus; PHONE_LEASE_OWNER=other python3 -m python_pkg.android_ui -s 23181JEGR08034 focus
verification.evidence: first call refreshed claude:4102845's lease; the foreign call waited 60 s and exited 3: 'phone 23181JEGR08034 held by claude:4102845 (android_ui focus) until 17:32:00'

risks: A session that keeps calling android_ui holds the phone indefinitely (by design); `python3 -m python_pkg.phone_lease release <serial>` drops it
Raw adb use bypasses the lease; only the sanctioned tools take it
rollback: Revert this commit; android_ui returns to lease-free operation
Validate: python3 -m python_pkg.android_ui focus runs without touching ~/.cache/phone-lease
